comment_regular: Oblivion NiTransformData binary load. In rotation, translation, scale order, reads a 32-bit count; for nonzero count reads numeric type, allocates through that channel/type factory, reads keys using the registered stride/reader, clamps count to 0xFFFF, and transfers the array to the corresponding ownership setter.
